attributes.action: Change the Regulation of Water Companies in Wales
attributes.additional_details:
Sewage is spilled an average of once every 5 minutes in Wales. 
 1.9% of sewage discharges are legal. The other 98.1% of sewage discharges are done illegally. Fining a company when they fail to self-regulate isn't a solution. We need change.
attributes.background: We need the UK Government to ensure that the replacement for Ofwat in Wales has the best interest of the Welsh people and the Welsh environment at its core. We need a regulator to hold Welsh Water accountable, instead of continuing with trusting water companies to self regulate.

rejection.details:
Petitions need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action.

We're not sure exactly what you'd like the UK Government or Parliament to do to "Change the Regulation of Water Companies in Wales" and to ensure the new regulator in Wales is effective.

You could start a new petition explaining clearly what you would like the UK Government or Parliament to do. Depending on the ask of the petition, it may be best directed to your representatives in Wales as it seems likely that regulation of water regulation will soon be devolved. 

In October 2024, the UK and Welsh Governments launched a joint Independent Commission into the water sector and its regulation. In July 2025, the final report of the Independent Commission was published. It recommended that Ofwat be abolished, a new single regulator be created for England, and regulation be devolved and integrated with the environmental regulator in Wales.

The Welsh Parliament has its own Petitions Committee. If you'd like to send your petition to the Welsh Parliament, you can find out more here: https://petitions.senedd.wales/

You may also wish to raise this issue with your local Members of the Senedd who represent you. You can find out who your Members of the Senedd are and how to contact them here: https://senedd.wales/find-a-member-of-the-senedd/
